description: Four low-frequency oscillators locked to the Tracker's beat, each with its own shape, rate and output range

params.text: Chooses that wave's shape: a rising ramp, a triangle, a sine or a square
Sets the rate of that wave against the track's beat: one cycle a beat in the middle, up to 32 cycles a beat turned right and one cycle every 32 beats turned left
Shifts that wave through its own cycle, a whole cycle across the travel
Bends that wave in time, stretching the first part of the cycle and squeezing the rest or the other way round; on the square wave it sets the pulse width instead
Sets the voltage the wave is built on, -5V to +5V
Sets how far that wave swings away from its OFFSET voltage, from -100% to +100% of 10V; a negative setting turns the wave over

outputs.text: That wave, running from its OFFSET voltage to that voltage plus the SCALE share of 10V

notes: nothing comes out of this until a Tracker module is somewhere in the patch; the two are joined through the plugin rather than by a cable, so where it goes in the rack does not matter.
while the track is stopped each output rests at its own OFFSET voltage; the waves only move while the Tracker is playing.
menu: Mode: Fixed, Loop — sets whether a divided wave restarts when a pattern loops or carries straight on through it; the maker marks Loop as not implemented
